assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All site, key-area and derived design geometry uses the maintainer-registered provisional substitute boundary (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-KEY-001/002/003). It is not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: When the official vector boundary is released, the land-use partition, all area metrics, five figures, drawings and the visual exhibition must be recomputed end-to-end.

assumptions.statement: Concept storey counts per land-use code (residential 12, AI R&D 10, commercial 8, education 6, health 6, community 4, cultural 3, sports 2) are design-testing assumptions, not statutory intensity controls.
assumptions.impact: Concept GFA (~27.96M sqm) and concept FAR (~2.45) are low-confidence design quantities; statutory FAR remains unknown pending official regulatory conditions.

assumptions.statement: The six global ecosystem case summaries are compiled from public institutional materials without independent verification of individual figures.
assumptions.impact: Cases inform design judgment only and are excluded from formal scoring evidence.

assumptions.statement: The Dazhongsi (Juesheng Temple) heritage awareness zone in constraints.geojson is a conceptual placeholder located inside the provisional key area, not the statutory protection boundary.
assumptions.impact: Formal design must adopt the boundary published by heritage authorities; any conflict overrides this package's concept layout.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, ownership, road redlines and municipal capacity data are unavailable in public channels; the land-use partition is a target structure, and building footprints are concept quantities that ignore retained existing structures.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classification stays principled, not parcel-level; density metrics must be recomputed after baseline surveys.
